_doc: Known-flaky suites (docs/systems/testing-tools.md, 'Flake budget and quarantine'). A quarantined suite always runs; until its expiry its failure prints KNOWN FLAKY and does not fail the run. Each entry needs an owner (who fixes the test), an expiry (ISO) and a reason. owners maps a suite (or part) to the session that fixes its flakes; the laptop queue quarantines over-budget suites itself for 48 h (C:/NightShift/scratch/laptop-queue/quarantine.json).
